newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 8.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 37.32 points to 7,858.49 as investors took profits after last week's powerful rally.
* Indonesia unveiled a fresh economic deregulation package on Monday, cutting tariffs on 1,600 items but introducing measures to limit loans to the property sector.

* On Monday, the Composite Index closed up 1.41 points, or 0.19 percent, at 738.01 points, pulled up by a spurt of late buying of blue chips after the market earlier underwent a brief consolidation period, brokers said.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,432.50/32.75 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,431.00/31.75.
* Property and banking stocks after the government announced measures to limit loans to the property sector.
* Food manufacturer Indofood and Mayora as sugar producers could import raw sugar, dismantling the monopoly held by state commodities regulator BULOG.
* Plantatation firms Bakrie Sumatra and London Sumatra as Indonesia has revised the export tax structure for palm oil under the latest economic deregulation package announced on Monday.
* Citra Marga on reports that one of its shareholders, state-owned PT Krakatau Steel, had sold 28.92 million shares, or a 2.89 percent stake, in the toll road operator.
* Property firm Duta Anggada Realty on reports the firm planned to set up a subsidiary in an effort to raise funds.
